1.why: All screens use a clean sans-serif face at comfortable size with reasonable line spacing between labels, headings and helper text.

2.why: No italics or dense paragraphs appear, but the step indicator 'STEP 1 OF 5' is rendered in all-caps, partially violating the statement.

3.why: Content sits in a single narrow centred column with stacked full-width fields and button, which reads well at mobile width.

4.why: Instructions such as 'Confirm your bank account details to protect higher-value payments' are one short plain sentence.

5.why: Both fields show example placeholders (marcus@example.test, +15551234567) plus a hint to use the displayed example details, though only sign-in inputs were ever reached.

6.why: Every screen contains only short headings and one-line supporting sentences; no long text block must be read to continue.

7.why: No secret, OTP seed or recovery code is ever displayed in any screenshot, so no copy affordance exists at all.

8.why: No QR code or any alternative to manual entry appears; the flow never reaches authenticator setup.

9.why: There is no password field and no visible indication of autofill/password-manager support; the placeholder-based demo credentials suggest manual entry only.

10.why: 'STEP 1 OF 5' plus a bold heading and a single high-contrast blue 'Continue securely' button make the step and primary action clear.

11.why: Each screen asks only for sign-in details with one primary button, though two fields must be completed together.

12.why: After submitting, the only feedback is 'Unable to sign in with those details' with no statement of what happens next, and the Logs panel remains empty.

13.why: The form can be resubmitted freely, but there are no reveal/hide or re-request code controls anywhere because codes are never generated.

14.why: 'Unable to sign in with those details.' identifies neither the specific problem nor how to fix it, although it avoids blaming language.

15.why: No countdown, expiry timer or session warning is shown on any screen, so nothing imposes a reading or entry time limit.
